instances.title: Instances
instances.subtitle: Manage and launch your Minecraft installations with isolated profiles.
instances.noInstancesDesc: Create an instance to download Minecraft, select your modloader and start playing.

instanceModal.title: New Minecraft Instance
instanceModal.desc: Configure the game version and desired modloader.

profiles.title: Local Profiles

profileModal.title: Create Offline Profile
profileModal.desc: Enter the player nickname you will use in-game and select an avatar.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: System information, language preferences, and advanced KatoLauncher options.
settings.languageDesc: Select your preferred language for the KatoLauncher interface.
settings.aboutDesc: Lightweight and modular Minecraft launcher with modloader and local profile support.
settings.javaDesc: KatoLauncher automatically detects and selects the exact Java version required by the chosen Minecraft era.
settings.ruleJava21: Minecraft 1.20.5 to 1.21+: Requires Java 21 (Ready with Temurin 21)
settings.ruleJava17: Minecraft 1.17 to 1.20.4: Requires Java 17 (Runs automatically with Java 21)
settings.ruleJava8Hint: If not installed, install Zulu 8 with:
settings.catalogDesc: Synchronized with official Mojang manifest (Piston Meta API).

footer.tagline: Your library and profile data remain on this device.

messages.needProfileFirst: You must create a profile before configuring an instance.
messages.confirmDeleteInstanceDesc: This action will permanently delete the instance folder with all its mods, worlds, and settings.
